Building N, sixth floor janitor station. The sewage line is intact, but our mobile wash cart banged hard against the utility sink P-trap and dislodged it.

sentences.text: Building N, sixth floor janitor station.

turns.text: Is the sink currently draining onto the floor?
Yes, every time the tap is used it pours straight out because the trap is detached. That is a plumbing fixture fault, not a building pipe collapse.

turns.text: When did the cart bump the sink trap?
About ten minutes ago. I shut off the wall water supplies right away.

turns.text: Plumber dispatched to re-seat and tighten the utility sink P-trap.
